trust_decision.summary: The project decides, in the C extension's items-view set operations, that the identity and value references taken while parsing each right-hand operand element must be released at the end of every loop iteration: two Py_CLEAR pairs are added to the reflected-union loop and the subtraction loop, plus the missing Py_CLEAR(arg) on the subtraction error path.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names 'items-view union and subtraction' and the changelog's first example is `operand | md.items()`, which is the operand-parsing loop of multidict_itemsview_or2_impl; a reader who greps for the parse loop and finds Py_CLEAR(arg) with no Py_CLEAR(identity)/Py_CLEAR(value) lands here first.

fix_sites.entry_point: `operand | md.items()` (reflected union: Py_nb_or -> multidict_itemsview_or -> Items_CheckExact(rht) branch -> multidict_itemsview_or2_impl)
fix_sites.module_kind: C extension core, shared multilib header compiled into the single multidict._multidict module

fix_sites.entry_point: `md.items() - operand` (Py_nb_subtract -> multidict_itemsview_sub1_impl); also reached by `md.items() ^ operand`, whose xor subtracts the operand set through the same function (views.h:907-911)
fix_sites.module_kind: C extension core, shared multilib header compiled into the single multidict._multidict module

fix_sites.entry_point: error path of the same `md.items() - operand` call: the fail label never released `arg` (and cleared `ret` twice)
fix_sites.module_kind: C extension core, shared multilib header compiled into the single multidict._multidict module

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: No out-of-scope source site: the pure-Python twin of these operations (multidict/_multidict_py.py:233, __ror__ at 366, __sub__ at 379) owns no C references so it cannot leak, and the proxy route (_multidict.c:1789-1791) returns the same ItemsView type from views.h, so the published fix correctly stays in one file.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: "xor is just subtract-then-union and the pure-Python implementation has no refcounting, so only the two C operand loops need touching" - both dismissals happen to be correct here, which is why this advisory has no genuinely unprotected route to argue away.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Operand elements that are not (key, value) 2-tuples must be copied verbatim into the result set - `md.items() | {'non-tuple', ('a','b','c')}` returns them unchanged and `md.items() - operand` still returns the view's pairs; a fix that treats an unparseable operand element as an error, or that releases the argument on the branch where the result set now owns it, breaks this documented behaviour.

O6_input_shapes: non-empty operand of (key, value) pairs (the leaking shape, which the pinned leak script never exercises)
operand elements that are not 2-tuples, or whose key is not hashable/str (parse returns 0 and the loop must still clear the previous element's refs)
list operand vs set operand (both consumed through PyObject_GetIter/PyIter_NextItem)
MultiDict and CIMultiDict items views (identical C loop, different identity mapper via md_calc_identity); the fix's test parametrises over both (fix.diff:88)

O7_producer.where: multidict/_multilib/views.h:189-230 (_multidict_itemsview_parse_item), which interns key identity via md_calc_identity at multidict/_multilib/hashtable.h:836 and hands the caller two new references; the pinned leak check (tests/isolated/multidict_itemsview_set_operations.py:20,26) passes an empty operand, so the producer is never called for any element and the leak is invisible.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a native itemsview_xor_impl that parses the operand in its own loop instead of delegating to PyNumber_Subtract
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the file already carries four per-operator impls plus a mirrored *_2 variant, so a maintainer writing xor natively (to avoid PySet_New(other)) matches the surrounding style and would need the same per-iteration clears

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an isdisjoint-style operand loop that forgets to clear identity/value on the skip (tmp == 0) branch
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: isdisjoint already parses every operand element and clears only at the loop tail - exactly the shape that leaked in or2/sub1

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second pass that re-walks matches via md_finder_collect and keeps a value alive across the set add
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: and1/or1/sub2 all materialise matches through md_finder_collect for __eq__ re-entrancy, so a variant that pins the value while comparing is a natural edit

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a pure-Python fast path that caches per-element identity objects in _tmp_set
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the Python twin mirrors the same two-phase tmp_set/entry-walk design, so a cached-identity optimisation there is the obvious port of the C structure

O9_family: reference-count leak / memory leak (CWE-401) in the C extension: one key and one value reference leaked per operand element, so memory grows with operand size

O10_build.toolchain: CPython >= 3.10 headers, C11 compiler (gcc), setuptools >= 47 via pyproject build-backend setuptools.build_meta, CFLAGS -O3 -Wall -Werror (-std=c11); test env needs pytest 9.1.1, hypothesis, objgraph 3.6.2, coverage (requirements/pytest.txt)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/isolated/multidict_itemsview_set_operations.py, driven by tests/test_leaks.py:11-35 in a subprocess under `coverage run`; operator-level cases in tests/test_multidict.py:1239-1373 and tests/test_hypothesis_views.py:126-129

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Fix only multidict_itemsview_sub1_impl because the summary's concrete example is `md.items() - operand`, or hoist a single Py_CLEAR pair to after the operand loop so only the last element's refs drop; the reflected-union loop in or2 keeps leaking and the existing empty-operand leak test still passes.

out_of_scope_notes: No defect outside this advisory's protection was found or pursued: the other items-view loops (and1/and2/or1/sub2/isdisjoint, views.h:244-322,335-407,443-524,754-835,1035-1101) release identity/key/value themselves, and the keys-view operations (views.h:1211-1720) carry no value references.
unverified: repo_mb was not measured (no shell available); source plus tests are ~20.4k non-empty lines over 56 files, which is the basis for the tiny_repo flag.

Slot dispatch was read, not executed: reflected union/subtraction reach the *_2 impls only because the dispatcher checks Items_CheckExact(rht) (views.h:651-652, 865-866), which the reflected-subtraction test expectation at tests/test_multidict.py:1338-1343 corroborates; no code was built or run.
Whether the fix's added union case (`union_operand | md.items()`, fix.diff:93-94) actually leaks without the or2 hunk could not be confirmed without a build.
Latest release code was not provided (none), so anything about present-day code is unknown.
